final:
-- Pure formatter: declares no capabilities, so it cannot print or touch files.
format_line(level: str, message: str) -> str =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  post out.char_count() >= 3
  ex format_line("INFO", "ready") == "[INFO] ready"
  "[\(level)] \(message)"

-- Prints one formatted line through io only. Declares no fs, so it cannot write a log file.
log_line(level: str, message: str) uses io =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  let line = format_line(level: level, message: message)
  io.print(line)
